Do not fear it.|Pav-ti Tano, to her daughter Ahsoka, during her child's first ritual hunt|}} '''Pav-ti Tano''' was a [[Togruta]] [[Gender|female]] from the [[planet]] [[Shili]] who was the partner of [[Nak-il Tano]] and the [[Parent|mother]] of [[Ahsoka Tano]]. Living in a small [[Ahsoka Tano's village|village]], she believed in the traditional ways of her people and wanted to take Ahsoka on her first hunt in [[36 BBY]], when she was just a baby. Venturing into the [[forest]]s and hunting a [[kybuck]] to teach her daughter about life and [[death]], Pav-ti was able to kill the creature, but a predatory [[raxshir]] soon arrived and took Ahsoka. Pav-ti was distraught, and the village sent several members to search for her missing daughter. That [[Local day|night]], Ahsoka returned, riding on the back of the beast, who delivered her back to the village before silently departing. As a relieved Pav-ti and Nak-il comforted their daughter, the village elder [[Gantika]] proclaimed that Ahsoka was a [[Jedi]]. Later, in [[33 BBY]], Ahsoka was taken from the family to be trained by the [[Jedi Order]]. ==Biography== ===Motherhood=== {{Quote|Ahsoka.|Pav-ti Tano speaks her daughter's name for the first time|}} [[File:Ahsoka_birth.png|thumb|left|325px|Gantika greets Pav-ti and her newborn daughter, Ahsoka.]] Pav-ti Tano was a [[Togruta]] [[Gender|female]] from the [[planet]]{{TOTJ|Life and Death}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[Shili]] who lived in a small, quiet{{InsiderCite|230|Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi Companion|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'' Companion}} [[Ahsoka Tano's village|village]]. One night in [[36 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Tano gave [[Reproduction|birth]] to a daughter whom she bore with her partner [[Nak-il Tano]]. Many villagers came to visit the [[Parent|mother]] and her newborn on the [[Local day|evening]] of the [[Youngling|baby's]] birth, including the village elder [[Gantika]]. It was then that Pav-ti announced that she had named her daughter [[Ahsoka Tano|Ahsoka]]. [[35 BBY|One year]] later, Pav-ti decided that, as per traditional Togruta custom, Ahsoka had reached the age where she was ready to join her mother on her first ritual hunt in the [[forest]]s of their [[homeworld]]. Donning a [[Color|blue]] cloak, carrying a [[backpack]], and securing her baby across her chest, Pav-ti walked outside as Nak-il was working on their roof. Her partner was unsure if their young daughter was ready for the adventure, although Pav-ti strongly believed in her people's traditions. Nak-il believed the old ways were for the elderly and not for the couple, but Pav-ti was resolute in her stance and warned Nak-il not to offend the spirits of their ancestors. Nak-il smiled and accepted his partner's beliefs, wishing her and Ahsoka a good hunt. ===The hunt=== {{Quote|Look, Ahsoka. Everywhere there is life. Value it. Honor it.|Pav-ti Tano, to Ahsoka|}} [[File:Togruta_ritual.png|thumb|right|350px|Pav-ti prepares to take Ahsoka on her first ritual hunt with the blessing of Gantika.]] On their way into the forests for the hunt, Pav-ti and Ahsoka encountered Gantika, who marked the foreheads of both mother and child with blue paint for luck. During their journey through the forest, Pav-ti emphasized the value of the life surrounding them to her daughter. Eventually, Pav-ti discovered a herd of [[kybuck]] in the long [[grass]] and shot one with her [[blaster rifle]]. With the kybuck incapacitated, Pav-ti approached and told a distressed Ahsoka that she must face [[death]]. The mother then comforted the animal before plunging a [[knife]] through its heart, causing a quick death for the beast. Pav-ti prepared to take its body back to the village when a predatory [[raxshir]] approached her and her child. Pav-ti attempted to ward off the [[feline]] before fighting it off with the butt of her [[rifle]]. When the raxshir noticed Ahsoka, however, Pav-ti began to fire at it. The sounds of her rifle alerted the villagers of trouble, and a group of them rushed into the forest to help her. She then used her knife to try and scare the creature off, although the raxshir managed to knock Pav-ti to the ground. As the raxshir went in for the kill, Ahsoka distracted the creature, saving her mother's life.{{InsiderCite|218|Ahsoka So Far}} The Togruta's people then arrived and attempted to shoot the beast. The raxshir leaped away but not before grabbing Ahsoka by the scruff of her collar, leaving Pav-ti in much distress and Nak-il to comfort her. Several members of the village began the search for Ahsoka. ===A gifted daughter=== {{Quote|Gantika, how could this be?''"
"''Jedi. Ahsoka is Jedi.|Pav-ti and Gantika|}} [[File:Ahsoka_is_Jedi.png|thumb|left|290px|Pav-ti and Nak-il discover that their infant daughter, Ahsoka, is a Jedi.]] By the evening, the Togruta had still not managed to find Ahsoka or the raxshir, leading Nak-il to suggest going out in force to rescue his infant daughter. It was then that the villagers heard the raxshir approaching them, but upon closer inspection, they discovered that Ahsoka was riding the beast. In disbelief, Pav-ti cautiously approached the raxshir and, as the creature bowed, took her baby from the raxshir's back. She thanked the animal before it departed and returned to the forest. Nak-il ran to his partner and daughter's side as their people surrounded them, and Pav-ti asked Gantika how her daughter's seemingly miraculous return could have happened. Gantika smiled and promulgated that Ahsoka was a [[Jedi]], shocking her parents. In [[33 BBY]], a young Ahsoka was discovered by [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] and taken to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant]] to train as a member of the [[Jedi Order]]. As she grew into adulthood, Ahsoka did not remember either of her parents well. When asked about her upbringing by the young [[farmer]] [[Kaeden Larte]] on the [[moon]] [[Raada]][[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] in [[18 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] to [[18 BBY]]. Tano, wanting her identity as a former Jedi to remain a secret, replied that she had been adopted. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Are you sure she's ready?''"
"''Nak-il, it is custom.|Pav-ti and Nak-il Tano discuss the prospect of Ahsoka's ritual hunt|}} [[File:LifeAndDeath.jpg|thumb|right|275px|A nurturing mother, Pav-ti was profoundly grateful when Ahsoka was returned safely.]] Pav-ti Tano was a Togruta female with orange skin, white-and-blue patterned [[lekku]] and [[montral]]s, and blue [[eye]]s. She also had white markings on her face. Pav-ti strongly adhered to her people's old traditions and practices—unlike her partner Nak-il, who was more laidback. Pav-ti was able to speak both [[Togruti]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard]]. A gentle and caring mother, Pav-ti was fiercely protective of her [[Tano family|family]]. She felt her people's values of recognizing life and facing death were important, taking Ahsoka on her first ritual hunt to teach her of their ways despite Nak-il's initial protests. Ultimately, Pav-ti's lesson to Ahsoka about valuing all forms of life helped her daughter connect with the natural world and, by extension, connect with the Force.{{InsiderCite|225|Children of the Galaxy (article)}} Although Ahsoka would not remember much about her mother as she grew older, Pav-ti's lesson would stay with her throughout her many adventures.{{InsiderCite|221|Space Moms}} ==Skills and abilities== Pav-ti was proficient with a blaster rifle, managing to incapacitate a kybuck in one shot. She was also adept with a knife, which she used to stab the kybuck through the [[heart]], causing it a swift and painless death. Pav-ti was also able to fend off and survive an attack from the raxshir. ==Equipment== Pav-ti wore a white long-sleeved [[Clothing|shirt]], a blue cloak, light blue pants, and brown [[boot]]s. She had a [[belt]] with pouches attached to it. During the hunt, Pav-ti made use of a walking stick while venturing into the forest. She later used both a [[blaster]] rifle and a knife on the hunt, wielding both weapons capably. ==Behind the scenes== ===Debut=== {{Quote|If you're just down to have fun, you get roped into things. Because it's a giant galaxy but it's actually cared for by a very small village.|Janina Gavankar, on becoming Pav-ti Tano|}} [[File:JaninaGavankarCelebrationPhoto.png|thumb|right|200px|Janina Gavankar, the voice of Pav-ti, at Star Wars Celebration.]] Pav-ti Tano was first indirectly mentioned in the [[2016]] novel [[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']], written by [[E. K. Johnston]]. She was later identified as Pav-ti in an article published on [[StarWars.com]] following [[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Star Wars Celebration Anaheim]] on [[May 29]], [[2022]], in the leadup to the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (television series)|Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi]]'', where she first appeared in the series' first episode, "[[Life and Death]]," released on [[Disney+]] on [[October 26]], 2022.{{SWYouTube|-uRRKqQbmw4|Tales Of The Jedi | Official Trailer | Disney Plus|sw_url=video/tales-of-the-jedi-official-trailer-disney}} Her surname of Tano was later given in the StarWars.com [[Databank]].{{Databank|ahsoka-tano|Ahsoka Tano}} Pav-ti was voiced by [[Janina Gavankar]], who had previously portrayed [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Commander]] [[Iden Versio]] in the [[2017]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''.{{StarWarsShow|YPvrArQPbjU|Star Wars Celebration Orlando 2017 Live Stream – Day 3 | The Star Wars Show LIVE!}} Gavankar was announced as having the role at Celebration Anaheim on [[May 28]], 2022, at the show's panel.{{WebCite|url=https://gizmodo.com/star-wars-tales-of-the-jedi-lucasfilm-anthology-series-1848974981|text=Ahsoka, Qui-Gon & Count Dooku Return in New Anthology Series, ''Tales of the Jedi''|author=Carter, Justin|date=2022-05-28|work=[[Wikipedia:Gizmodo|''Gizmodo'']]|archivedate=20220529061105}} As someone with previous work in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, Gavankar described herself as a caretaker to the story and was happy to help further it in new and exciting ways. She described the show as minimalistic, quiet, and reserved. ===Development=== {{Quote|It was really, really interesting to see Ahsoka's backstory as a baby and to see everyone in her town. I always wanted to know her backstory. I remember Dave being coy about it. What I gathered from his answers was that it was a story that he always wanted to tell. So, it's very cool that he finally got the chance to tell it.|Ashley Eckstein|}} [[File:Life_and_Death_Poster.png|thumb|left|225px|A poster for the episode "Life and Death," in which Pav-ti Tano first appeared.]] Although Pav-ti did not appear until ''Tales of the Jedi'', a reference to Ahsoka Tano's mother was first thought of by the show's supervising director, [[Dave Filoni]], during script-writing for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', specifically for the episode "[[Escape from Kadavo]],"{{WebCite|url=http://theforce.net/topstory/story/Filoni_On_ForceCast_TCW_Will_Explore_Order_66_143192.asp|text=Filoni On ForceCast: TCW Will Explore Order 66|date=2012-01-21|archivedate=20120122230210}} which premiered [[January 6]], [[2012]], ten years before ''Tales of the Jedi''.{{InsiderCite|130|Launchpad}} In an early version of the script, Filoni included a scene of the Togruta [[governor]] [[Gupat Roshti]] telling Ahsoka that he knew her parents, implying that Ahsoka's instinct to save the people of [[Kiros]] was thanks to them. However, the idea was dropped because the writers did not want to flesh out Ahsoka's backstory. Filoni also stated that he felt that Roshti saying that felt like a "mean" thing to do. [[Ashley Eckstein]], who voiced Ahsoka in ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'', had always been curious about her character's backstory and had asked Filoni about it. His reluctance to fully elaborate on it made Eckstein feel that Filoni had ideas about it that he wanted to use in a story. Eckstein found it interesting to see Ahsoka's community. Concept artist [[Molly Denmark]] created several lighting concepts for the episode that included Pav-ti, including depictions of the Togrutan village,{{SW|url=star-wars-tales-of-the-jedi-concept-art-gallery|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi | Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 24}} the surrounding forest,{{SW|url=star-wars-tales-of-the-jedi-concept-art-gallery|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi | Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 25}} and Pav-ti and Ahsoka during the hunt.{{SW|url=star-wars-tales-of-the-jedi-concept-art-gallery|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi | Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 26}} Artist [[Chris Madden]] worked on concept art of Pav-ti's character design.{{SW|url=star-wars-tales-of-the-jedi-concept-art-gallery|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi | Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}} Associate storyboard artist [[Justin Bruce Lee]] created storyboards for the episode that included scenes of Pav-ti and Ahsoka during the hunt as well as Pav-ti's battle with the raxshir.{{Twitter|username=justbleeve|url=/status/1585334380460810240|name=[[Justin Bruce Lee]]|date=2022-10-26|quote=Tales of the Jedi is finally out on @disneyplus!So thankful to learn under my episodic director @natenewton and master Dave filoni. Also very thankful to my whole team for inspiring me every day!|archivedate=2024-11-28|archivefile=File:JustinBruceLee-RaxshirStoryboards-Twitter.png}}{{Twitter|username=justbleeve|url=/status/1585334806811844609|name=[[Justin Bruce Lee]]|date=2022-10-26|quote=Pt 2 of my thumbnails!|archivedate=2024-11-28|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/UuOG4}} Sketches of Pav-ti from Filoni's sketchbook was shared at an exhibit celebrating [[Lucasfilm Animation]]'s twentieth anniversary at San Diego Comic-Con [[2025]]. The exhibit was available from [[July 24]] to [[July 27]], 2025.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-san-diego-comic-con-ahsoka-season-2-first-look|text=Never-Before-Seen Art Celebrates 20 Years of Lucasfilm
